_comment: Official closing rules a weekly opening-hours list cannot express, keyed by post id. Read at build by src/lib/venue-calendar.mjs: the itinerary page turns them into the dates where the plain 'Monday: Closed' list is wrong, so the arrival-date warning matches the venue's own calendar. Add a venue only from its official site, with source and checked date. Holidays come from data/country-facts.json (country).

tokyo-shinjuku-gyoen-national-garden.note: Closed Mondays (if Monday is a national holiday, closed on the next weekday); closed Dec 29 - Jan 3; open 7 days Mar 25 - Apr 24 and Nov 1 - 15.
